detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 video

I built ReachWeaver, an open-source Claude Code plugin. It drafts a post per platform, shows exactly what would be sent, and sends nothing until I approve that exact text. Instagram, TikTok and YouTube stay manual. Offline demo with a placeholder account; nothing was posted. AI-generated voice.

https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver

#ClaudeCode #OpenSource #DevTools #AI #Programming
